title: Detecting Religious Language in Climate Discourse

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM zero-shot classifications and argumentations against a rule-based ecotheology hierarchical tree on climate discourse sentences, specifically analyzing the models' tendency to privilege explicit, conventional institutional religions while marginalizing implicit or nature-based spiritualities.

Qualitatively analyzing LLM responses to determine if their concept of 'religion' is skewed toward Western or 'World Religion' paradigms, systematically excluding or misclassifying indigenous cultural-spiritual concepts like 'Mother Earth' and 'Ubuntu'.
